newsitem.title: USA: Peerless 5.9 pct stake held by Cannell.
newsitem.headline: Peerless 5.9 pct stake held by Cannell.

text.p: San Francisco-based Cannell Capital Management said Friday it holds a 5.9 percent stake in Peerless Manufacturing Co, or 85,600 shares.

Cannell said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that it holds the shares for investment but has submitted a proposal to Peerless for its 1997 proxy, calling on the company to "immediately retain" an adviser to help maximize shareholder value, which could result in the sale or merger of the company.
"As of this date, (Peerless) has not acquiesced to such request," Cannell said in the filing.
Cannell most recently bought a net 14,600 shares in the Dallas-based maker of equipment for the petroleum and natural gas industry, between May 5 and June 11 at $10.02 each.
